Your iPhone 17 supports **up to 25W wireless charging**, but your old wireless charger is probably limited to 7.5W or 15W.

To get the full 25W, you need two things:

1. **A Qi2.2 (Qi2 25W) certified magnetic wireless charger**, or Apple's newer 25W MagSafe Charger.
2. **A USB-C power adapter rated at 30W or higher.**

### Why your old charger is slow

| Charger type | Maximum wireless power |
|---|---:|
| Older standard Qi | 7.5W |
| Older MagSafe | 15W |
| Original Qi2 | 15W |
| Qi2.2 (25W) | 25W |
| New Apple 25W MagSafe | 25W |

A more powerful wall adapter alone won't fix an older wireless charging pad. <Cite refs={["turn131598view0"]}/>

### My advice

I'd buy the **ESR Cyclone 25W Qi2 charger plus a 35W USB-C adapter**. That's a good combination if your main goal is getting the full wireless charging speed.

One important detail: make sure the product explicitly says **Qi2.2 25W**, not merely Qi2 or 25W in its marketing title.
